name: article
description: Constrained reading-width page with title header and optional share bar. Share bar is on by default; opt out per-page with share_bar: false in a :::settings block.

detect.note: This stylesheet also owns .share-bar / .share-btn, which themes/_base/partials/share-bar.njk renders on ordinary pages — not just article-shaped ones. Detecting only .article-page dropped the share-bar styling on 33 melt pages.
